ns2:course.label: Ikebana: Japanese Floral Arts
ns2:course.description: Through lectures, selected readings and hands-on experience of Ikebana (the art of Japanese flower arrangement), students will gain new perspectives on artistic and cultural heritage of Japan. Furthermore, they will be guided towards a means of applying these disciplines, ideas and philosophies into their daily lives, thereby enriching their experience and cultivating themselves to be well-rounded human beings.
